service.name: Rathalos (Mount)
service.longDescription: The King of the Skies descends upon Eorzea — the Monster Hunter crossover mount, dropped by Rathalos in The Great Hunt on Extreme. Guaranteed with 50 Rathalos Scales+ or a lucky drop.
